2026-11-23.patch_summary: This patch breaks out the cache flushing logic from the __get_user_pages() function into a separate helper function called gup_flush_pages(). The new function takes in the vm_area_struct, address, pages array, and number of pages as parameters. It flushes the caches for each page in the specified range using the flush_anon_page() and flush_dcache_page() functions. This change is intended to improve code organization and maintainability without introducing any functional changes.
